Name: Seasonal Cozy Bus
Author: kiwisprinkle
Description:
Another day another bus mod! This one is a bit less extreme than the last, I opted for a softer type of vibe with, again, seasonal changes to suit the flow of the year.

You can change the recolor option through the config file or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. There's recolor compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url]. Default is set to vanilla coloring.

Please let me know if you find any errors. Enjoy :D

Downloads.Description: A bus recolor that changes with the seasons.
